brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Ireland team will wear black armbands and players voted to go ahead with a game against Israel. [1]
Ireland skipped handshakes and bowed heads before a win over Israel. [3]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR IRELAND
The decision to proceed with the Israel game while wearing black armbands may reflect domestic political sensitivities, as Ireland is linked to 8 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations. [1][E2]

KEY RISKS
Ireland's net energy import dependency of 80% poses a risk of supply disruption or price volatility. [E3]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of Ireland's game against Israel and any further actions by the team or government remain unresolved. [1][3]
